description: This file defines structures, functions, and constants for managing Multiple Masters and GX variable fonts in the FreeType project. It includes data structures for font axes, styles, and descriptors, as well as functions to retrieve and set font design coordinates and variations.

methods.name: FT_Get_Multi_Master
methods.description: Retrieves the Multiple Master descriptor for a font face.

methods.name: FT_Get_MM_Var
methods.description: Retrieves the Multiple Master or GX variable descriptor for a font face.

methods.name: FT_Set_MM_Design_Coordinates
methods.description: Sets the design coordinates for a Multiple Masters font.

methods.name: FT_Set_Var_Design_Coordinates
methods.description: Sets the design coordinates for a variable font (Multiple Masters or GX).

methods.name: FT_Set_MM_Blend_Coordinates
methods.description: Sets normalized blend coordinates for a font.
